intelligibility: The voice is clear and easy to understand throughout the recording.
voice_delivery: The narration is performed at a professional, appropriate pace and with a neutral, engaging tone.
music_and_effect_balance: The background music and sound effects are well-balanced and do not overpower or mask the narration.
sonic_defects: The audio contains no noticeable sonic defects like harsh hiss, pumping, or excessive drone.
tail_quality: The tail is clean and fits the recording.
material_improvements: The audio quality is professional and serves its purpose well. No improvements are necessary.
